study.question: Observation: static, pooled and adapted DIN validation AUCs are 0.6050036145, 0.6102261137 and 0.6133619861. The incumbent g2-r0001-target_separate reaches 0.6153351064 versus 0.6146090565 for shared consensus and 0.6110239483 for context-only separate reads. Its code constrains each retrieval query to one current-ad field: category retrieval cannot inspect current brand before aggregation, and vice versa. Does coupling the two current-ad queries improve evidence selection beyond an equally sized own-field projection, while preserving separate reads and both query and history-summary norms?
study.hypothesis: Provisional mechanism hypothesis, not an established observed bottleneck: the usefulness of a historical category may depend on current brand and vice versa. A residual other-field projection can rotate each query to use that context before the existing nonlinear relation scorer, retaining separate aligned retrieval rather than merging softmaxes or changing value routing. Review of negative trajectories: round 0 pooled directional/scalar variants did not beat adapted DIN; round 2 union routing (0.6149204868) and crossed values (0.6138332320) did not beat aligned reads; round 3 action stratification (0.6144010686) and shifted action metadata (0.6134877323) underperformed; round 4 wider late fusion (0.6143827904) and duplicated-sum control (0.6142683553) underperformed; round 5 excluding action/age from semantic keys (0.6140649094 versus 0.6153351064) also hurt, while its context variant was worse than mixed context (0.6094652228 versus 0.6110239483). Accordingly preserve the incumbent keys, values, read separation and width and intervene only before scoring. Replays at the same seed provide reproducibility evidence, not independent mechanism support. No execution failures are reported in the supplied trajectory index; negative results are scientific counterevidence to those specific implementations, not missing data. QueryFormer supplies relevant query-refinement prior art, not local evidence that the proposed bottleneck exists.

inherited_components: All embeddings, action/recency encoding, shared DIN-style relation scorer and classifier construction/order from candidate.py at entry (g2-r0001-target_separate). Baseline reference SHA256 ee10868f589c077b19f57a1fb07702c947c56e970994cdc537ef83ea2b8bc943 was checked unchanged.
Separate category/brand masked softmaxes; mixed field plus action/age keys; category attention reads category values, brand attention reads brand values, their mean reads common metadata.
Masked-mean history supplies target-independent summary magnitude; zero/empty histories use the inherited finite reference fallback. Current static fields still enter the classifier in all cells.

Literal dimensions, learning rate, fixed host initialization seed, scratch training, BCE, optimizer and sample coverage remain inherited. No inaccessible item identities, dense features, future events or auxiliary labels.
study.proposed_difference: Add a shared bias-free 16x16 projection after all inherited modules, initialized to zero. For each of the two unmodified base queries q_f, compute q_raw_f=q_f+W*q_other and match its norm back to ||q_f|| (fallback to q_f below 1e-6). The capacity control replaces q_other with q_f using the same parameters and operations. Cross/context and self/context controls replace current-ad base queries by the existing masked field history means. All computations are per impression; base queries are read simultaneously, with no sequential update, new event information, classifier width or change in value routing. Missing/zero own queries remain zero even when the counterpart exists; this design cannot recover a missing own field. Expected total parameters per cell are 17130531 (=17130275+256), subject to host measurement. Query and summary norms constrain magnitude but do not fix attention entropy or optimization. This is mechanism-distinct from prior key removal, action pooling, value routing and late-fusion experiments.
predictions: Primary: seed-42 AUC(cross_target) exceeds AUC(self_target) and the 0.6153351064 unrefined incumbent; report absolute deltas and unweighted Logloss rather than infer significance. Selection uses full validation only.

Specificity: D_target=AUC(cross_target)-AUC(self_target) is positive and exceeds D_context=AUC(cross_context)-AUC(self_context). A larger cross_target-than-self_target gain alone is insufficient to establish target specificity.

Implementation: learned W need not stay zero; projection-off attention/logit changes and query-angle changes should be nonzero for an active mechanism, while query/summary norm errors remain below a predeclared float32 relative tolerance 1e-4 (absolute 1e-5 for near-zero reference norms); padding mass and empty-history summary should be zero. Diagnostics use only the first 512 validation impressions and are candidate-supplied sensitivity checks, not population estimates.

Report host-provided history-length, hour, behavior, frequency and category-match slice counts with AUC/Logloss; mark insufficient classes. The incumbent is worse than DIN for history_1_16 (0.5729240 vs 0.5745702; 41805 impressions, 1444 positive, 40361 negative), but better for category_match_absent (0.6183088 vs 0.6176437; 717129 impressions, 29616 positive, 687513 negative). These retrospectively inspected slices are exploratory context, not proof of the query hypothesis or confirmatory slice selection. The proposed primary contrast remains full-population validation AUC. No guaranteed slice rescue is predicted.

If screening supports the direction, repeat all four cells at seeds 43 and 44, preserving source and config. Report paired differences and their variation; a positive mean with inconsistent signs is weak evidence. User-cluster bootstrap only if the host later exposes an authorized paired interface; it is not available in this coding phase.
falsifiers: If cross_target does not outperform both the capacity-matched self_target and unrefined parent under the frozen population protocol, this implementation fails the proposed practical benefit. One failed implementation does not refute every cross-field conditioning method.
If D_target is nonpositive or D_target-D_context is nonpositive, the target-specific coupling interpretation is unsupported, even if a model happens to beat a weaker historical baseline.

If the learned intervention has negligible query/attention/logit effect, a score gain cannot be confidently attributed to active cross-field use. These diagnostics alone cannot validate a performance mechanism.

If gains are accompanied by norm violations, padding leakage, nonfinite outputs, differing sample coverage or a resource cap violation, reject the comparison for integrity/execution reasons rather than count it as mechanism support.

If paired-seed differences reverse, or improvements require materially worse measured compute/latency or Logloss, narrow or retract the practical claim and retain all outcomes. No efficiency claim without measured cost.
alternative_explanations: The existing nonlinear relation scorer plus downstream static MLP may already model sufficient field context, making refinement unnecessary.
The cross-field projection may improve optimization or regularization rather than identify better evidence. Self-refinement is an allocated-capacity control but not a perfect functional match.
Other-field information may merely act as a surrogate for category/brand frequency or missingness. Host slices can suggest but not prove this explanation.

Any advantage may come from generic coupling of history means or altered attention concentration; the full query-source factorial and projection-off diagnostics discriminate only parts of this account.
Single-seed validation search, best-checkpoint selection and repeated use of the validation population can create optimistic selection; same-seed identical replays do not remove that uncertainty.

Zero initialization can leave useful coupling undertrained in three epochs, and norm matching can suppress useful scale or missing-field recovery. A negative result is limited to this constrained implementation.
Publisher static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented under the frozen benchmark assumption; no production point-in-time validity is established.

contrasts.intervention: cross_target: q_c = norm_match(q_c + W q_b, q_c), q_b = norm_match(q_b + W q_c, q_b); one shared zero-initialized bias-free W of shape [16,16], applied simultaneously to unrefined current-ad queries. Keep separate aligned reads.
contrasts.control: self_target: replace the other-field input to exactly the same W by the own-field query. This gives equal trainable capacity and projection operations without other-current-field information at retrieval. Existing g2-r0005-mixed_target is the unrefined same-seed parent reference; its 0.6153351064 AUC is not treated as a new independent repetition.
held_fixed: All first-six-day exposures at natural prevalence and the frozen causal prefix, history limit 128, batches 4096, three host epochs, seed 42 initially.
Same embedding size 16, hidden widths [128,64], separate field softmaxes, mixed semantic/action/age keys, aligned field values and averaged metadata weights.
Same projection tensor construction/order, zero initialization, own-query norm reference, pooled history norm reference, Adam lr 0.001 and host BCE loss.
Same static features, output width, scorers, best-checkpoint policy, diagnostic scope and sample identities. No optimizer, auxiliary-label, sequence-budget or split change.
remaining_confounds: Equal allocated capacity does not guarantee equal effective capacity; cross and self projection inputs have different distributions and gradient paths.
Query norm matching removes Euclidean magnitude changes, not entropy changes or field-specific optimization effects.
Four seed-42 screens alone cannot establish robustness, statistical significance or broad novelty.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If cross_target exceeds both self_target and the unrefined parent in full validation AUC without a material Logloss regression, inspect projection-off attention/logit sensitivity and query-norm diagnostics, then repeat the complete factorial at paired seeds 43 and 44 before claiming repeated support. A small positive screen is provisional.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Keep the incumbent. If self_target helps equally, prefer a generic query reparameterization explanation. If cross_target changes attention but underperforms, record failure of this implementation; only consider a different query mechanism after a separate prospective discriminating plan, never infer all cross-field query mechanisms are refuted.

contrasts.control: self_context uses the same history means with own-field projection. Compare D_target = AUC(cross_target)-AUC(self_target) with D_context = AUC(cross_context)-AUC(self_context). All four cells have identical parameter shapes and construction order.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: Require finite logits plus near-zero query/summary norm errors, zero padding attention and zero empty-history summary. contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Any shape, finiteness or masking failure is an execution failure, charged to the ledger and corrected through a new recorded attempt; it is not scientific counterevidence. A near-zero learned W is evidence of an unused intervention, not proof that conditioning is useless.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Read exact-version primary arxiv:2609.16548v1 section 4.2 lines 128-192. Unlike the previous declared consideration (latest usage only altered key composition and did not improve the incumbent), this proposal implements a concrete query-refinement intervention. The local motivation is the one-field query restriction and failed attempts to change downstream readout/keys, not an assumption that source pCVR results transfer.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Reduce pre-retrieval field-query interaction to a single shared zero-start linear residual from the other field, at fixed query norm. Replace it by own-field projection for attribution and compare current-ad versus history-only query sources.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Projection-only minimal contrast, not the reported attention-generated bridge, Co-Transformer, sequence re-query, embedding-view scaling or auxiliary delay training. Source advises attention rather than projection alone; this simpler replacement tests whether local cross-field information is useful before adopting that cost. Novelty and source-transfer efficacy remain unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Nonpositive cross_target-minus-self_target, nonpositive factorial specificity, or failure to beat the unrefined incumbent weakens this local adaptation. No result of this small projection test validates or refutes full QueryFormer.
